params.name: legal_entity_id
params.description: The unique identifier (public ID) for the legal entity.

params.name: date_start
params.description: Start date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Must not be earlier than 5 years ago.

params.name: date_end
params.description: End date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Must not exceed 5 years in the future.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor, CUID or UUID format.

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of payroll events for a specified legal entity.
 **Token scopes**: `legal-entity:read`
